_readme: ICONIQ Growth publishes no team page (the iconiq.com sitemap has none; checked 2026-09-29). The people here are the growth desk's investors whom a dated first-party record names with a title: the firm's own welcome, promotion and interview posts (live on iconiq.com, or archived by Common Crawl from iconiqcapital.com, whose original address is given), the adviser's Form ADV Schedule A (ICONIQ Capital, LLC, CRD 159198, amendment of 2026-08-12), and for two partners the person's own event or investor profile. url is the record that gives the title. Left out: Michael Anders (co-founder, the wealth side), Chad Boeding (left in 2018), the umbrella's operating officers on Schedule A (Louis Thorne, Jason Craig, Katherine Dougan, Kevin Foster), Chris Degnan (a go-to-market advisor from October 2025) and Anu Bharadwaj ('Partner at ICONIQ Capital since April 2026' in Toast's 2026 proxy; no ICONIQ Growth record names her desk). No social link is guessed (COLLECTION.md 11).
